moment.text: this artist was particularly fond of signing his name on his drawings; and not only does he give his name, but sometimes also the date and the circumstances under which he made the picture.
it needed a man of a certain roughness of temperament to break with the modest habit of his predecessors, who rarely signed their pictures

matters.text: The moment the Uzbegs had left, the seyyeds and leading men of Mašhad sent a courier to Farhad Khan at Dastjerd. Farhad Khan marched the same hour to Mašhad, entered the city, visited the shrine of the Imam Reza, and reported to the Shah
